text:
This calculator will allow you to check how much in National Insurance contributions an employee needs to pay.

Using the calculator

If you’re an employee

Use the calculator to find out if the amount of National Insurance contributions you’ve paid is correct.

If you’re an employer

Use the calculator to find out how much National Insurance you need to deduct from your employees’ pay.

If you’re a software developer

Check the payroll software you have developed is calculating National Insurance contributions for employees and employers correctly.

Before you start

This calculator is only for the current tax year.

You’ll need:

the period of pay, which could be:

weekly

every 2 weeks

every 4 weeks

monthly

the date you were paid, if you’re an employee

the date you paid your employee, if you’re an employer

the amount paid before any deductions

the employee’s National Insurance category letter — this can be found on the employee’s payslip
